title: Pocket FM
description: A custom FM interface with a miniature-radio design and a 76-108 MHz tuning implementation. Wired earphones are needed for antenna/audio testing. Exact tuner silicon, extended-band reception, audio routing and full restoration remain unverified on hardware. This app does not replace the original Sony FM program.
changes: Experimental native extended-band implementation. Offline tests are not proof of RF reception or audible output.
